parameters.text:
=Extract IELTS Writing Task 2 essay details from the provided text into a clean JSON object.
CRITICAL: This MUST be IELTS Writing Task 2 (Opinion, Discussion, Problem-Solution, Advantage-Disadvantage, Direct Question essay).
DO NOT extract Task 1 (charts, tables, diagrams, maps, or graph descriptions). If any Task 1 content exists, ignore it and extract ONLY Task 2.
Only extract the highest band sample essays (e.g. Band 8 or Band 9). Skip lower band essays.

CRITICAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. "task": Always "Task 2".
2. "essay_type": Specific essay type (e.g. "Opinion Essay", "Discussion Essay", "Problem-Solution", "Advantage-Disadvantage", "Direct Question").
3. "title": A concise, engaging title for the essay topic (e.g. "Air Travel Restrictions", "Childcare Courses for Both Parents", "Commercial Places in City Planning").
4. "question": Extract the exact IELTS Writing Task 2 essay prompt/question.
5. "outline": Object with concise structure for "introduction", "body", and "conclusion".
6. "sample_answers": For each sample essay found, extract the FULL VERBATIM essay text into the "essay" field with its band score in "band". DO NOT summarize. Keep all paragraphs intact.
7. "vocabulary": Array of key topical vocabulary words or collocations extracted from the article.

Article text:
{{ $json.clean_article_text }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ielts_writing_tasks (
  task_type, essay_type, title, question, outline, sample_answers, vocabulary, source_url, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8, NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_url) 
DO UPDATE SET
  task_type = EXCLUDED.task_type,
  essay_type = EXCLUDED.essay_type,
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  question = EXCLUDED.question,
  outline = EXCLUDED.outline,
  sample_answers = EXCLUDED.sample_answers,
  vocabulary = EXCLUDED.vocabulary,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, title, task_type;
